stories.title: LLSWS 2026 — North Carolina Wins 4th Title, 2-0 Over Kentucky

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
North Carolina did it.

Johnston County wins the 2026 LLSWS championship 2-0 over Kentucky. Anna-Lynn Clark: 93 pitches. Complete game. Shutout. Six strikeouts.

41 total strikeouts in the tournament. That's the most dominant run Greenville has ever seen. 🥎 #LLSWS #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
North Carolina is a four-time Little League Softball World Series champion.

2015. 2019. 2024. 2026.

Johnston County just joined history. 4th title, all in the modern era. 🥎 #LLSWS #Softball #NorthCarolina

research.facts:
LLSWS 2026 — North Carolina Wins Championship
**Sources:**
- MLB.com — "North Carolina wins 2026 Little League Softball World Series" (confirmed result, score, Clark stats)
- WITN.com — "Johnston County wins Softball LLWS" (local coverage, confirmed 2-0 final)
- WRAL.com — Championship game story (confirmed details)
- Bleacher Report — "Who Won 2026 Little League Softball World Series" (confirmed)
- Yahoo Sports — "Johnston County, NC wins LLSWS" (confirmed)
- TSN.ca — "North Carolina shuts out Kentucky to win 2026 LLSWS" (confirmed shutout)
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence — 5+ sources):**
- Result: North Carolina 2, Kentucky 0
- Date: August 9, 2026, 3 PM ET, Stallings Stadium, Greenville, NC (ABC)
- Scoring: Belle Cox RBI single in 2nd inning scored Scarlett Cerda (1-0); 2nd run scored on Kentucky error in 3rd
- Anna-Lynn Clark: 93 pitches, CG shutout, 3 H, 6 K; did not allow runner past 2nd base in final 5 innings
- Clark tournament totals: 41 strikeouts (led all pitchers), 20 of NC's 24 tournament innings pitched, 3 ER allowed total
- Previous tournament: Clark had 3 games with 10+ strikeouts; semifinal vs FL = 109 pitches, 11 K, shutout
- NC's 4th LLSWS title (2015, 2019, 2024, 2026) — Johnston County Little League, Clayton, NC (Southeast Region)
- NC now trails only Texas (14), Florida (8), California (5) in all-time LLSWS titles
**Freshness:** Championship game was yesterday (Aug 9). This is the victory celebration/recap angle for Aug 10.
